SELECT q.QUO_YM AS quoYm, q.QUO_SEQ AS quoSeq, FN_GET_SEQSTRING('Q', q.QUO_YM, q.TYPE, q.QUO_SEQ) AS quoId, IFNULL(q.CHQ_SEQ, 0) AS chqSeq, DATE_FORMAT(q.ISSUE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS issueDt, IFNULL(q.TOTAL_VAT, 0) AS quoTotalVat, j.CMPY_SEQ AS cmpySeq, IFNULL(j.CMPY_NAME, '') AS cmpyName, IFNULL(FN_MEM_NAME(j.MNG_ID), '-') AS mngName, IFNULL(mem.WORK_STATE, '') AS mngWorkState, IFNULL(j.PRDCT_NAME, '') AS prdctName, CONCAT( 'SB', j.SBK_YM, '-', j.SBK_TYPE, LPAD(j.SBK_SEQ, 4, 0), '-', IF(t.TEST_TYPE_CODE = 'NS', 'SF', t.TEST_TYPE_CODE), LPAD(t.TEST_NO, 4, 0) ) AS testId, t.TEST_TYPE_CODE AS deptCode, IFNULL(cc.TYPE_NAME, t.TEST_TYPE_CODE) AS deptName, IFNULL(ti.NET_SALES, 0) AS netSales, DATE_FORMAT(t.TEST_STATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS doneDt, IFNULL(qs.doneCnt, 0) AS quoDoneCnt, IFNULL(qs.cancelCnt, 0) AS quoCancelCnt, IFNULL(qs.skipCnt, 0) AS quoSkipCnt, IFNULL(qs.noReportCnt, 0) AS quoNoReportCnt, IFNULL(sls.hasSls, 0) AS hasSls FROM TEST_TB t INNER JOIN TEST_ITEM_TB ti ON ti.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = t.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND ti.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN JOB_TB j ON j.QUO_YM = ti.QUO_YM AND j.QUO_SEQ = ti.QUO_SEQ AND j.STATE <> 'D' INNER JOIN QUO_TB q ON q.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND q.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ LEFT JOIN COMCODE_TB cc ON cc.TOP_CD = 'TT' AND cc.TYPE_CD = t.TEST_TYPE_CODE
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_TB mem ON mem.ID = j.MNG_ID
INNER JOIN ( SELECT ti2.QUO_YM, ti2.QUO_SEQ, SUM(t2.TEST_STATE_CODE NOT IN (18, 19, 20)) AS openCnt, SUM(t2.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18) AS doneCnt, SUM(t2.TEST_STATE_CODE = 19) AS cancelCnt, SUM(t2.TEST_STATE_CODE = 20) AS skipCnt, SUM(t2.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18 AND t2.REPORT_DT IS NULL AND IFNULL(t2.REPORT_NO, '') = '') AS noReportCnt FROM TEST_ITEM_TB ti2 INNER JOIN TEST_TB t2 ON t2.TEST_ITEM_SEQ = ti2.TEST_ITEM_SEQ AND t2.STATE <> 'D' WHERE ti2.STATE <> 'D' GROUP BY ti2.QUO_YM, ti2.QUO_SEQ ) qs ON qs.QUO_YM = q.QUO_YM AND qs.QUO_SEQ = q.QUO_SEQ AND qs.openCnt = 0
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT qq.QUO_YM, qq.QUO_SEQ, MAX(1) AS hasSls FROM QUO_TB qq INNER JOIN SLS_TB s ON s.STATE <> 'D' AND ( (s.QUO_YM = qq.QUO_YM AND s.QUO_SEQ = qq.QUO_SEQ) OR (IFNULL(qq.CHQ_SEQ, 0) <> 0 AND s.CHQ_YM = qq.CHQ_YM AND s.CHQ_SEQ = qq.CHQ_SEQ) ) GROUP BY qq.QUO_YM, qq.QUO_SEQ ) sls ON sls.QUO_YM = q.QUO_YM AND sls.QUO_SEQ = q.QUO_SEQ WHERE t.TEST_STATE_CODE = 18 AND t.STATE <> 'D' AND IFNULL(q.TOTAL_VAT, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUO_TB qb INNER JOIN SLS_TB s2 ON s2.STATE <> 'D' AND ( (s2.QUO_YM = qb.QUO_YM AND s2.QUO_SEQ = qb.QUO_SEQ) OR (IFNULL(qb.CHQ_SEQ, 0) <> 0 AND s2.CHQ_YM = qb.CHQ_YM AND s2.CHQ_SEQ = qb.CHQ_SEQ) ) INNER JOIN BILL_TB b ON b.SLS_YM = s2.SLS_YM AND b.SLS_SEQ = s2.SLS_SEQ AND b.BILL_YN = 1 AND b.STATE NOT IN (4, 6) WHERE qb.QUO_YM = j.QUO_YM AND qb.QUO_SEQ = j.QUO_SEQ ) AND q.QUO_YM not like '23%' ORDER BY t.TEST_STATE_DT
